workout.calibrating: Get into position and hold still
workout.setupInstruction: Place your phone in front of you so your whole body is visible in the camera.
workout.setupHint: Lean it against something stable, screen facing you, about a metre in front of your hands.

issue.NO_POSE: I can't see you in the frame
issue.TOO_FAR: You're too far — move the phone closer

permission.title: Camera access needed
permission.body: The camera is only used to count push-ups. The image is analysed on your phone and is never saved or uploaded.
permission.denied: Camera access was denied. You can enable it in your system settings.

error.noCamera: No camera found on this device.
error.modelMissing: The model file is missing. Run "npm run fetch-model" and rebuild the app.
error.modelFailed: Could not load the body detection model.
error.cameraBusy: The camera is being used by another app. Close it and try again.
error.insecureContext: The camera works only over HTTPS. Open the page at an address starting with "https://".
error.cameraFailed: The camera could not be started. Check whether another app is using it.

manual.title: Add push-ups manually
manual.body: Enter the number of push-ups you did without the camera.

friends.title: Friends

friends.empty: No friends yet. Send someone your code.
friends.alreadyFriends: You're already friends with this person

profile.title: Profile
profile.signOutConfirm: Are you sure you want to sign out?

settings.title: Settings
settings.goalNoOverrides: No exceptions — every day uses the default goal
settings.remindersDenied: Notifications are turned off in your system settings.
settings.remindersHint: We won't send a reminder if today's goal is already met.
settings.debugOverlayHint: Useful for fine-tuning push-up detection on your phone.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.statement: Camera data is processed locally on your device and is not uploaded or stored.
privacy.details: During a workout the app analyses the position of your shoulders, elbows and wrists directly in your phone's memory. Camera frames are never written to disk or sent over the internet.
privacy.whatWeSyncBody: Results only: push-up counts, number of sets, workout time and date, your goal, your streak and your friends list.
privacy.whatStaysLocalBody: Settings, theme, language and reminder times.

onboarding.welcomeSubtitle: Put your phone in front of you and train. We'll handle the rest.
onboarding.signInHint: Signing in is only needed to save your results and compare them with friends.
onboarding.usernameSubtitle: This is how friends will see you on the leaderboard.
onboarding.usernameInvalid: Use 3–20 characters: letters, digits, dot or underscore
onboarding.goalSubtitle: You can always change this in settings.
onboarding.setupBody: Place your phone in front of you so your whole body is visible in the camera. Leaning it against a wall works best.
onboarding.privacyNote: Camera data never leaves your phone.

notifications.reminderRemaining: You have {{count}} push-ups left to reach today's goal.
notifications.permissionBody: So we can remind you about your daily goal.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No internet connection. Your workouts are saved on your phone and will sync later.
errors.googleNotConfigured: Google sign-in isn't configured yet. Fill in the .env file as described in the README.
errors.supabaseNotConfigured: The backend isn't configured. Fill in the .env file as described in the README.
errors.storageUnavailable: The local database could not be opened. Check whether your browser is blocking site data — the app may not work in private mode. Try reloading the page.
